'''Gammack''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served in the [[Third Battalion (Calamari Defense Force)|Third Battalion]] during the [[Battle of Calamari]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During the battle, Captain Gammack ordered evac shuttles to the frontlines to carry out the wounded before the [[World Devastator]]s could overrun their positions. He also protested the decision to pull back to a location far from the main battle, but was told it was to avoid getting caught in a wedge formation by the Devastators.

After a brief discussion, he was granted time to send a message to the Republic [[Pinnacle Base|base]] on the moon of [[Da Soocha V]]. His message was only partially sent, as the World Devastators reached his position before he could finish.

When [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] task force reached [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]] contacted Gammack, telling him to prepare his troops for evacuation. Gammack expressed his relief and informed the squadron leader that his battalion was the only unit left in the sector of the battle.
When the Devastators released the [[TIE/D automated starfighter]]s, he informed Green Leader of the fighters on his tail, but was unable to prevent his death.

After the battle turned against the New Republic, he attempted to shore up his soldiers' remaining [[Amphibion]] attack boats for a boarding attempt of the nearest Devastators.
When the ships were affected by the overriding command signal, Gammack's troops boarded the Devastators and fought their way onto their decks, only to be told by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to leave the craft as they were about to be destroyed.
